name: Toolbar: File and Route menus instead of Open and New route; with no file only New route and Open can be used
A click on File opens it, a click on Route switches to Route, a second click closes it; Esc closes the menu and returns focus to its button
Keyboard: Arrow down on a menu button opens it at the first item, arrows move over the usable items only, Arrow right goes to the next menu (with nothing usable the focus stays on its button)
An open route: File and Route items can be used; Edit route is ticked while the mode is on; choosing an item closes the menu
A click into the map while a menu is open only closes the menu: no waypoint is added (the same click without a menu adds one)
File → Close closes an unchanged file; in planning Close leaves the planning
Phone 320 px wide: the toolbar fits, the menu opens below its button inside the screen with large items
